source: Curated ComicsBox USA series codes, ComicsBox USA series indexes, protagonist credits, and existing MarvelTracker paths
rules: Dedicated character series are explicitly pinned by ComicsBox code and title in this versioned source manifest.
The ComicsBox character-publication endpoint is not used because it currently returns a global table for unrelated character slugs.
Additional team/co-billed sources marked protagonistOnly are filtered story by story using ComicsBox protagonist credits.
Shared history is reused only when the character is credited among the protagonists of a USA story already represented by MarvelTracker.
Simple appearances and cameos are excluded unless an exact historically important issue is explicitly selected.
A physical Italian issue keeps its global ownership identity; reading progress remains path-local through readingStep.contentIds.
Ultimate, Age of Apocalypse, What If and explicit alternate/cross-company continuities are excluded from these Earth-616 paths.
Missing Italian first publications remain explicit audit gaps and are never replaced with invented editions.
